testcase.system-out: Scenario: Return to tab key tips after a partial command key tip ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ When the user presses Alt and then "M" ✔ Then the 3D Model command key tips appear ✔ When the user presses "H" ✔ Then the visible command key tips narrow to H-prefixed entries ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the tab and quick-access key tips appear ✔ And the command key tips are no longer displayed ✔ When the user presses "M" ✔ Then the 3D Model command key tips appear again ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then the key tips disappear ✔ And the part remains visible
